answers.how: The cat moves about 118 pixels in 2.042 seconds, giving a scale of approximately 0.018 m/pixel. Its horizontal extent including the tail is about 48 pixels.
Using the motion-derived scale of approximately 0.018 m/pixel, the cat's vertical extent including the tail is about 35 pixels.
The front beach chair is about 84 pixels wide. Multiplying by the motion-derived scale of approximately 0.018 m/pixel gives its width.
Adjacent vertical pool-tile joints are about 67 pixels apart. Using the motion-derived scale of approximately 0.018 m/pixel gives the horizontal tile width.
